notice: Nur explizit benannte Tabellen und nachweisbar definierte Felder. Nicht genannte Felder sind im damaligen Entwurf nicht bestimmt. null bedeutet nicht festgelegt.

tables.name: Accounts
tables.contract: `Id bigint`, `Email citext UNIQUE NOT NULL`, `EmailVerifiedAt timestamptz NULL`, **non-unique** `DisplayName`, `AccountRoleTypeId smallint FK`, enabled/timestamps. No `UserName` or `NormalizedUserName` login identity.

tables.name: AccountRoleTypes
tables.contract: Built-in `Owner`, `MediaManager`, `User`; instance-level roles, not profile ownership.

tables.name: Profiles
tables.contract: `Id bigint`, `OwnerAccountId bigint FK Accounts`, non-unique `DisplayName`, `UiLocaleId bigint FK UiLocales`, selection PIN hash (optional), restrictions/preferences.

tables.name: AccountProfiles
tables.contract: Composite PK `(AccountId,ProfileId)`, FKs to `Accounts` and `Profiles`; which Accounts may **select/use** a Profile; **no `CanManage` field**. Profile management by `Profiles.OwnerAccountId` or authorized instance-role action.

tables.name: AccountPasswords
tables.contract: Password hash & rotation metadata; per Account, no secret plaintext.

tables.name: AccountPasskeys
tables.contract: WebAuthn credential id, public key, flags, counters and metadata; **never private keys**.

tables.name: AccountTotpFactors
tables.contract: Encrypted TOTP secret and one-way hashed recovery codes; own lifecycles.

tables.name: AccountRecoveryCodes
tables.contract: Encrypted TOTP secret and one-way hashed recovery codes; own lifecycles.

tables.name: AccountExternalLogins
tables.contract: External provider login identity linked to Account; unique external provider identity. **Distinct from profile-scoped service sync Connections**.

tables.name: AccountAuthChallenges
tables.contract: Bounded/expiring verification, reset, enrollment and WebAuthn challenges.

tables.name: AccountSessions
tables.contract: Durable Account sign-in/refresh and revocation; current Profile selected in this context; token secret stored hashed.

tables.name: PlaybackSessions
tables.contract: Active **or ended** playback, asset/file/device/mode and `EndedAt`; separate domain from AccountSessions.

tables.name: AccountPermissions
tables.contract: Only explicit overrides if supported by effective authorization contracts; avoid parallel role engines.

tables.name: UiLocales
tables.contract: `Id bigint PK`, `Locale varchar(...) UNIQUE` plus names/direction/enabled state.

tables.name: MediaTypes
tables.contract: Seeded types `Movie`, `Series`, `Book`, `Manga`, `LightNovel`, `Music`, **`Game`**. Anime is a classification of Movie/Series.

tables.name: Works
tables.contract: Canonical `Id bigint`, `MediaTypeId smallint FK MediaTypes`, `CanonicalTitle` as a deliberately managed resolved/display projection, dates.

tables.name: WorkTitles
tables.contract: Original/localized/alternate/search titles with provenance; authoritative titles are **not duplicated** in separate localized-facts tables.

tables.name: WorkExternalIdentities
tables.contract: Correctable provider mappings, namespace and evidence; never an alternative Work ID.

tables.name: WorkMetadataFacts
tables.contract: Canonical facts, localized **non-title** values, provenance/manual-override protection.

tables.name: WorkLocalizedValues
tables.contract: Canonical facts, localized **non-title** values, provenance/manual-override protection.

tables.name: WorkFieldProvenance
tables.contract: Canonical facts, localized **non-title** values, provenance/manual-override protection.

tables.name: WorkRelations
tables.contract: Directed prequel/adaptation links are **not** the same as group membership; franchise membership references `WorkId bigint`.

tables.name: Franchises
tables.contract: Directed prequel/adaptation links are **not** the same as group membership; franchise membership references `WorkId bigint`.

tables.name: FranchiseWorks
tables.contract: Directed prequel/adaptation links are **not** the same as group membership; franchise membership references `WorkId bigint`.

tables.name: WorkMediaClassifications
tables.contract: Join of Works to fixed classification types, including Anime; no separate Anime table.

tables.name: WorkSeasons
tables.contract: Canonical logical units; their internal IDs use bigint in the new baseline, FK to Work; no legacy episode/chapter id.

tables.name: WorkEpisodes
tables.contract: Canonical logical units; their internal IDs use bigint in the new baseline, FK to Work; no legacy episode/chapter id.

tables.name: WorkVolumes
tables.contract: Canonical logical units; their internal IDs use bigint in the new baseline, FK to Work; no legacy episode/chapter id.

tables.name: WorkChapters
tables.contract: Canonical logical units; their internal IDs use bigint in the new baseline, FK to Work; no legacy episode/chapter id.

tables.name: WorkTracks
tables.contract: Canonical logical units; their internal IDs use bigint in the new baseline, FK to Work; no legacy episode/chapter id.

tables.name: WorkEditions
tables.contract: One edition/version/asset/file/inventory chain for all formats. Asset kind as `MediaAssetTypeId` FK; technical stream kind as `MediaTrackTypeId` FK.

tables.name: WorkVersions
tables.contract: One edition/version/asset/file/inventory chain for all formats. Asset kind as `MediaAssetTypeId` FK; technical stream kind as `MediaTrackTypeId` FK.

tables.name: MediaAssets
tables.contract: One edition/version/asset/file/inventory chain for all formats. Asset kind as `MediaAssetTypeId` FK; technical stream kind as `MediaTrackTypeId` FK.

tables.name: StoredFiles
tables.contract: One edition/version/asset/file/inventory chain for all formats. Asset kind as `MediaAssetTypeId` FK; technical stream kind as `MediaTrackTypeId` FK.

tables.name: MediaTracks
tables.contract: One edition/version/asset/file/inventory chain for all formats. Asset kind as `MediaAssetTypeId` FK; technical stream kind as `MediaTrackTypeId` FK.

tables.name: MediaTechnicalAnalyses
tables.contract: One edition/version/asset/file/inventory chain for all formats. Asset kind as `MediaAssetTypeId` FK; technical stream kind as `MediaTrackTypeId` FK.

tables.name: LibraryRoots
tables.contract: One edition/version/asset/file/inventory chain for all formats. Asset kind as `MediaAssetTypeId` FK; technical stream kind as `MediaTrackTypeId` FK.

tables.name: EditionExternalIdentities
tables.contract: Generic ISBN/ASIN/provider identity and audiobook narrators, publishers etc.; no permanent `AudiobookEditionMetadata` duplicate.

tables.name: WorkCredits
tables.contract: Generic ISBN/ASIN/provider identity and audiobook narrators, publishers etc.; no permanent `AudiobookEditionMetadata` duplicate.

tables.name: GamePlatforms
tables.contract: Genuine dynamic platform identities.

tables.name: GameReleases
tables.contract: **Game-specific extension** with `WorkVersionId bigint PK/FK WorkVersions`, `GamePlatformId bigint FK GamePlatforms`, revision/region/release details. Do not create `Games.Id`.

tables.name: GameReleaseStoredFiles
tables.contract: Only where ordered/disc/multi-file release membership is needed: `WorkVersionId -> GameReleases.WorkVersionId` and `StoredFileId -> StoredFiles.Id`, disc/sequence/file-role type. The WorkVersionId is the shared PK/FK of the GameRelease extension; there is no independent GameRelease root. Avoid duplicate `GameReleaseFiles` file identity.

tables.name: StoredFileHashes
tables.contract: File-level checksum facts; preserve distinct release-level evidence only if technically necessary and normalized.

tables.name: Images
tables.contract: One image identity and file/hash/mime/dimensions; binaries live under owned storage, not PostgreSQL.

tables.name: ImageTypes
tables.contract: Poster/Cover/Banner/Backdrop/Logo/Chapter/Screenshot/etc.; translated via UI catalog, stable machine `Key`.

tables.name: ImageAssignments
tables.contract: `ImageId`, `ImageTypeId`, locale/region/source/priority/manual choice; **exactly one** explicit target FK (`WorkId`, `WorkChapterId`, `MediaChapterId`, etc.); games use **WorkId**, not a GameId. CHECK for exactly-one target. This is an intentional generic relationship table exception.

tables.name: ImageGenerationRequests
tables.contract: Generation requests, prompt metadata, profile, operation, accepted Image ID; named presets only if configurable; **no global `ArtworkStyles` enum**.

tables.name: ImageGenerationPresets
tables.contract: Generation requests, prompt metadata, profile, operation, accepted Image ID; named presets only if configurable; **no global `ArtworkStyles` enum**.

tables.name: MediaChapters
tables.contract: Named chapter/navigation timeline on exact `MediaAssetId`, start/end, chapter ordering, source; distinct from logical written `WorkChapters`.

tables.name: MediaSegments
tables.contract: Skip markers on exact `MediaAssetId`: Intro/OP, Recap, Outro/ED, Credits, Preview. **Outro and Credits can overlap**, multiple markers per kind possible; manual corrections outrank imported/provider/detector markers.

tables.name: MediaSegmentTypes
tables.contract: Fixed `...Types` for marker meaning and source.

tables.name: MediaSegmentSourceTypes
tables.contract: Fixed `...Types` for marker meaning and source.

tables.name: MediaDetectionRuns
tables.contract: Detector kind, algorithm version, media/content fingerprint, status, number of matches, timestamps and error, **including successful no-match runs** to prevent infinite reprocessing.

tables.name: MediaDetectionTypes
tables.contract: Seeded fixed detector kind/status types.

tables.name: MediaDetectionStatusTypes
tables.contract: Seeded fixed detector kind/status types.

tables.name: ReaderContent
tables.contract: Canonical reading content/navigation annotations. Reader text anchors and edition content identity remain stable for sync.

tables.name: ReaderPages
tables.contract: Canonical reading content/navigation annotations. Reader text anchors and edition content identity remain stable for sync.

tables.name: ReaderBookmarks
tables.contract: Canonical reading content/navigation annotations. Reader text anchors and edition content identity remain stable for sync.

tables.name: ReaderHighlights
tables.contract: Canonical reading content/navigation annotations. Reader text anchors and edition content identity remain stable for sync.

tables.name: MediaProgress
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: Shared identity: `ProfileId bigint FK`, `WorkId bigint FK`, optional canonical target unit FK, `ProgressPositionTypeId smallint FK`, `IsCompleted`, timestamps. One current row per Profile + target.

tables.name: ProgressPositionTypes
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: `Time`, `Reading`, `Game` fixed values.

tables.name: TimeProgressPositions
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: 1:1 `MediaProgressId PK/FK`; `PositionMs`, `DurationMs`. Video/audio/music.

tables.name: ReadingProgressPositions
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: 1:1 `MediaProgressId PK/FK`; `WorkEditionId`, page index, text locator JSONB, per-mille and relevant content/version anchor. Reader/manga/novels.

tables.name: GameProgressPositions
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: 1:1 `MediaProgressId PK/FK`; play time and optional verified/explicit progress %. **Time played is not completion percent**. Savegames/activity sessions are separate if implemented.

tables.name: MediaPlaybackHistory
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: Playback/history events independent of current progress. Reader and gameplay history likewise belong in explicit activity events if their semantics differ.

tables.name: WatchlistEntries
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: Composite `(ProfileId,WorkId)` FK to Profiles/Works. No provider-ID composite masquerading as Work identity.

tables.name: Collections
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: Profile ownership; Work-based membership and ratings, no separate Anime/Manga/etc. user lists.

tables.name: CollectionWorks
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: Profile ownership; Work-based membership and ratings, no separate Anime/Manga/etc. user lists.

tables.name: ProfileRatings
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: Profile ownership; Work-based membership and ratings, no separate Anime/Manga/etc. user lists.

tables.name: UiTranslationMessages
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: **One** central catalog for UI/validation/errors; stable machine message key, language fallback exact -> parent -> English, generated/manual/review state. `UiTranslations` links `UiLocaleId -> UiLocales.Id` and `UiTranslationMessageId -> UiTranslationMessages.Id`; `UiTranslationMessages.Key` unique. No `ErrorTranslations` or duplicate Learning/player catalogs.

tables.name: UiTranslations
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: **One** central catalog for UI/validation/errors; stable machine message key, language fallback exact -> parent -> English, generated/manual/review state. `UiTranslations` links `UiLocaleId -> UiLocales.Id` and `UiTranslationMessageId -> UiTranslationMessages.Id`; `UiTranslationMessages.Key` unique. No `ErrorTranslations` or duplicate Learning/player catalogs.

tables.name: Operations
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: Existing shared background-operation owner reused by acquisitions, import, artwork, detection, media preparation etc.

tables.name: OperationLogs
tables.area: Progress, personal state, collections and UI
tables.contract: Existing shared background-operation owner reused by acquisitions, import, artwork, detection, media preparation etc.
